description: This file implements the LifecycleInterfaceConnector class, which manages interactions with the LifecycleManager remote object, handles app lifecycle events, and provides APIs for launching, preloading, closing, terminating, killing, and sending intents to applications within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: LifecycleInterfaceConnector
classes.description: Manages app lifecycle interactions with the remote LifecycleManager, handles app state change events, and provides APIs for app control within the plugin.

methods.name: createLifecycleManagerRemoteObject
methods.description: Initializes remote objects for lifecycle management and registers for state change notifications.

methods.name: releaseLifecycleManagerRemoteObject
methods.description: Releases remote objects and unregisters notifications.

methods.name: isAppLoaded
methods.description: Checks if a specific app is loaded.

methods.name: launch
methods.description: Launches an app with specified intent and runtime configuration.

methods.name: preLoadApp
methods.description: Preloads an app with specified launch arguments and runtime configuration.

methods.name: closeApp
methods.description: Closes an app, attempting to pause and unload it.

methods.name: sendIntent
methods.description: Sends an intent to an active app.

methods.name: getLoadedApps
methods.description: Retrieves the list of loaded apps and their states.

methods.name: mapAppLifecycleState
methods.description: Maps internal lifecycle states to application lifecycle states.

methods.name: OnAppLifecycleStateChanged
methods.description: Handles app lifecycle state change events and updates internal app info accordingly.

methods.name: GetAppInstanceId
methods.description: Retrieves the app instance ID for a given app ID.

methods.name: fileExists
methods.description: Checks if a given file exists and is a regular file.
